images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, a mobile-thumbnail-readable blockbuster micro-story with a dominant protagonist performing one decisive action. world: Classical sculpture museum, event: Meteor crystal catch, outcome: one tiny pawprint stops the machine, role: eccentric comic antihero, location: flower-filled cloud garden, prop: transparent emergency cable spool, twist: the explosion becomes a storm of flowers, expression: intense suspicious side-eye, gesture: heroic low crouch, visual_hook: miniature city foreground. An attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. The cat catches a glowing meteor crystal against a transparent emergency cable spool while marble statues awaken through projection, then a visible tiny pawprint on the oversized machine shuts it down and the apparent explosion becomes harmless flower petals. Miniature city foreground, towering statue silhouettes, crystal scale, cable arcs and strong side-eye make the cause and consequence instantly readable. Three-quarter low viewpoint, medium-close distance, 18mm lens, crisp cat and prop with layered cloud depth, golden sunset rim light and cool museum fill.
